title: Algorithm variants configuration
description: Declarative GA composition (Design B, DP11-1) or monolithic class loading. Every strategy class named here must exist in algorithms.strategies.STRATEGY_REGISTRY, and every parameter key must be accepted by the class constructor (DP11-5).

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference used by editors for completion and validation.

default_params.description: Genetic Algorithm defaults applied to every variant unless overridden.

population_size.description: Number of individuals kept per generation.

mutation_rate.description: Per-individual probability of applying the mutation operator.

seed.description: Base random seed; repetitions offset it.

algorithm_configs.description: Variant name -> configuration. Variant names are the labels reported in checkpoints and statistics.

metaheuristic.description: Metaheuristic identifier; `GeneticAlgorithm` selects the modular pipeline, any other value requires `class_module`/`class_name`.

use_gpu.description: Whether the variant needs CuPy/CUDA at run time (the benchmark skips GPU variants when no device is present).

class_module.description: Dotted module path for monolithic variants resolved by `AlgorithmConfig.get_class()`.

params.description: Algorithm-level parameters. Modular pipelines accept `local_search_stage`, `population_size`, `mutation_rate` and `seed`.

tournament_size.description: Monolithic-only alias of the selection tournament size.

two_opt_iterations.description: Monolithic-only alias of the 2-opt pass cap.

strategies.description: Strategy slot -> class + parameters (Design B). Slots omitted from the pipeline stay `None`.

local_search_stage.description: Where the local-search strategy runs inside the generation pipeline (`LocalSearchStage`).

class.description: Key of `STRATEGY_REGISTRY`; the slot prefix identifies the stage.

params.description: Constructor keyword arguments for the strategy class. Shared keys: `seed`, `candidate_k`, `return_gpu`, `max_matrix_dimension`, `max_shared_tour_cities`, `mode`.

seed.description: Explicit seed override; the loader injects the run seed when omitted.

return_gpu.description: Keep produced routes/costs in VRAM instead of returning host arrays.

candidate_k.description: Nearest-neighbour list width; `null` keeps the exhaustive scan (DP10-20).

max_iterations.description: 2-opt pass cap for the local-search strategies.

mode.description: Acceptance rule: `best`/`first`/`multi_move` on CPU; `batch`/`multi_move`/`naive` on GPU.

threads_per_block.description: CUDA threads per block for the GPU strategies.

max_matrix_dimension.description: `n` above which coordinate-based problems use on-the-fly distances; `null` defers to `DEFAULT_MAX_MATRIX_DIMENSION` (10 000).

max_shared_tour_cities.description: `n` above which the GPU 2-opt scans the tour tile by tile instead of caching it in shared memory (default 11 520).
